thread:
maria (ML Eval): Heads up — I'm collecting metric definitions for the new eval runner. Needs: pass@k, exact match, ROUGE/BLEU, BERTScore, and calibration histograms. Also seeing CI failures that look like runner nondeterminism.

sam: For pass@k — do we pick k=1/5/10 per workload? we should also pick an estimator (the unbiased one for sampled generations).

jordan: Found a runner bug: dedup across prompts is collapsing valid candidates which breaks pass@k. Repro: 
```
# simplified repro
cands = ["yes", "yes", "no"]
# pipeline currently does global dedup -> ["yes","no"]
# should dedup only per-prompt candidate variants
```

eval-bot: Test run finished: /reports/2024-04/eval/1718254321/bert-compare.html :white_check_mark:

maria (ML Eval): Good catch. Rule: dedup only within a single prompt's output set, and keep stable ordering so pass@k counts are consistent. For calibration we want ECE (10 buckets by default) + reliability curve. Buckets: [0.0,0.1,...,1.0].

sam: For BLEU/ROUGE let's use sacrebleu + rouge-score. Config idea: smoothing=exp, use both sentence-level and corpus-level, but report corpus-level as primary. Add exact-match for QA spans (string normalize: lowercase, strip, collapse-whitespace).

jordan: CI wiring notes — flaky when randomness isn't seeded. Add deterministic param to runner (seed=42) and include a tiny synthetic dataset in CI (5 examples) with expected metric tolerances. Also add a regression gate: fail if BERTScore F1 drops > 0.02 or EM drops > 0.01.

maria (ML Eval): I'll add unit tests and a golden CSV. For pass@k, doc the estimator: use the improved estimator (https://arxiv.org/abs/1902.09677) and include both naive count-based and estimator outputs in reports.

sam: Quick note on pass@k formula for readme: we should show both the direct Monte Carlo estimate and the closed-form unbiased estimator. I'll paste snippets in the PR. :memo:

devops: I can plumb metrics into Prometheus/Grafana. Plan: export gauge eval_metric_value{model,metric,split} and a eval_metric_delta for last-run vs baseline. Retention: 90d for high-res. I'll open infra PR and add a prometheus exporter stub.

maria (ML Eval): Dashboard requirements: per-model panels for each metric with delta sparkline, historical table, and a calibration histogram widget. Add alerting rules for regression gates. Tagging: model_version, quantization (fp16/int8), dataset.

ejordan: One more runner bug — BLEU uses tokenization mismatch vs sacrebleu default. Make tokenizer explicit in eval config (`tokenizer: sacrebleu_tok`). Failing tests came from this.

sam: Sweet. Next steps: sam -> write pass@k docs + estimator code, maria -> add unit tests + golden file, jordan -> fix dedup + tokenizer, devops -> exporter PR. I'll schedule a 30m sync if anyone wants to pair on the CI gating.

maria (ML Eval): Thanks — ping me if you need sample golden outputs. I'll file an umbrella issue with tasks and PR links. :raised_hands:
